## e2e/FuluExecutionBranch_e2e_dec_generated.bend
import ../src/model.bend as API
import ../src/buffer.bend as B
import ../src/obj.bend as O
import ../types/schema.bend as S
import ../spec/primitives.bend as SP
import ../proofs/compact/found.bend as FD
import ../types/FuluExecutionBranch_decode_ssz_generated.bend as FuluExecutionBranch_r
import ../spec/fulu_schemas.bend as Spec
import ../proofs/obj/words_root_light.bend as WR
def FuluExecutionBranch_mv(m: Maybe<&1, O.Words>) -> Maybe<&2, S.Value>:
  match m:
    case None{}: None{}
    case Some{o}: Some{FuluExecutionBranch_ov(o)}
def FuluExecutionBranch_ov(o: O.Words) -> S.Value:
